layouts.name: Penbay FIA International Drag
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The supplied layout identifies a straight rather than a closed circuit. The race organizer describes a 700 m drag straight including start and deceleration distance. Exact independent public nodes retain the northern straight extension and western main straight, with no return loop or invented endpoint. The 727.2 m mapped extent includes the full available straight and is not asserted to be a homologated timed distance. Only one shared timing marker is supplied; a separate timed finish and direction remain unverified. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 727.2 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
